name: BSA A65 (Lightning, Thunderbolt, Spitfire)
engine: 654 cc air-cooled OHV unit-construction parallel twin, one or two Amal carbs, points ignition
intro: BSA's unit 650 twin. Amal carbs, points, Lucas electrics and a timing-side main bearing that needs checking.

add.title: Check the bottom end before a full rebuild
add.instructions: Check oil pressure and listen for knocking at the timing side. Ask about the timing-side main bush and whether it has been converted to a bearing.
add.reason: The A65's timing-side plain bush is a known weak point when worn.

G: Lightnings run twin Amals. Thunderbolts run one. Check what you have before buying parts.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
